name: Integrated Child Development Services- Uttarakhand
benefit:
**The following services are provided free of cost through Anganwadi Centres:**

- Supplementary nutrition, immunisation/vaccination, and related services for children between 6 months and 3 years.
- Immunisation/vaccination, pre-school education, and related services for children aged 3 to 6 years.
- Immunisation/vaccination, health check-ups, nutrition, and health education services for pregnant
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. All children between 6 months and 6 years, as well as pregnant women and lactating mothers, are eligible to avail benefits under this scheme. 1. There is no income limit for availing the benefits of this scheme.
